title: Hormone Replacement Therapy After Risk Reducing Salpingo-oophorectomy
official: Patient Centered Education About Hormone Replacement Therapy After Risk Reducing Salpingo-oophorectomy: a Pilot Randomized Controlled Trial
summary: The goal of this study is to develop an educational aid about hormone replacement therapy that physicians can share with patients as part of their pre-surgical counseling for a risk-reducing salpingo-oophorectomy (RRSO).
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* BRCA1 or BRCA2 germline mutation
* scheduled for a risk-reducing salpingo-oophorectomy (RRSO) by Duke Gynecologic Oncologist
* premenopausal

Exclusion Criteria:

* personal history of cancer
* postmenopausal
* \>50 years old
* unable to provide informed consent in English
